preprocessing.selection: largest detected person by bounding-box area

limits: Cropping reduces background but does not improve weak or stale height/weight labels.
The detector selecting one person does not prove that the selected person is the named celebrity.
The held-out cropped-image model still underperformed the fixed population baseline and was not promoted.
